description: Send the SkyAccess team a short note about how this connector worked: a SkyAccess tool that failed or returned something confusing or wrong, something the user wanted that no tool offers, or something that worked well. It is meant for the agent to send on its own when it notices one of these, so the user does not have to report it; a problem reported here, rather than worked around silently, is how the team learns to fix it. It needs no account, creates no booking or request and changes nothing for the user. Leave out names, e-mail addresses, phone numbers and other personal details.

category.description: Optional. One of: tool_error, missing_capability, confusing_result, wrong_data, worked_well, other.

message.description: What happened, in your own words: what you tried, what went wrong or was missing, and what would have helped. The first 2000 characters are kept. No names, e-mail addresses, phone numbers or other personal details.

toolName.description: Optional. The SkyAccess tool the feedback is about.

userGoal.description: Optional. What the user was trying to do, in one sentence, as you understand it from the conversation (for example "a one-way flight from New York to Miami for 6 people next Friday").

name: submit_feedback
title: Send feedback about this connector
